I found Alice's body here in cafeteria when I arrived just now. Let me give you my route: I started in upper engine, went to oxygen, back to upper engine, down to lower engine, then storage, medbay, electrical, and finally cafeteria where I found Alice dead.

Encounters: I saw Charlie in oxygen early (tick 2) and again in electrical at tick 25. Diana was in electrical for several ticks (22, 23, 24). I also saw Bob leave storage heading to lower engine around tick 10. Eve was moving between electrical and medbay around tick 22 — she came into electrical from security, then left to medbay.

I don't have a strong suspect yet — I want to hear where everyone was, especially right before the body was found. Whoever was last near cafeteria is who I'm most interested in. Let's hear everyone out.

Thanks Frank. Here's my route: I started in oxygen, went up to upper engine, down to lower engine, through storage, into medbay, and ended in electrical where Frank found me at tick 25.

Encounters: I saw Frank leave oxygen heading to upper engine at tick 2 — that matches his story. I saw Diana in upper engine around ticks 6-8, she came in from lower engine. I saw Bob in lower engine ticks 18-20; he had entered from storage around tick 12. And I saw Frank in electrical at tick 25, which lines up with his route.

A few things stand out: Frank says he saw Diana in electrical at ticks 22-24, but Diana was in upper engine when I saw her earlier — she could have moved across the map by then, that's plausible. Frank also mentions Eve was moving between electrical and medbay around tick 22 — I was in medbay around then heading to electrical, and I don't recall seeing Eve. That's worth Eve clarifying.

I never went near cafeteria this round, so I can't speak to who was up there with Alice. I'd really like to hear from Eve and Diana about their routes — especially anyone who was near cafeteria late in the round. No strong accusation from me yet.

I can confirm Frank's sighting of me late in the round. I was mostly on the right side of the ship this time. I started in electrical, went right to security, then up to weapons to do my tasks. After finishing up there, I headed back down through security and into electrical — which is exactly when I crossed paths with Frank and Diana around tick 22. 

From electrical, I went left into medbay and then straight down to storage to do the Sort Cargo task. Charlie, since I was just passing through medbay on my way to storage late in the round, we probably just barely missed each other in transit. 

Because I spent the first half of the round around security and weapons, I didn't see anyone heading up towards cafeteria, so I have no idea who was with Alice. Let's hear from Diana and Bob—hopefully one of them saw someone near the top of the map. No strong reads from me just yet.

Thanks everyone. Here's my route: I started in navigation, went up through storage, then into lower engine, and finally up to upper engine where I was when the meeting was called.

Encounters: I saw Frank enter storage from lower engine at tick 10 — that matches his stated route perfectly. Then I saw Charlie in lower engine at ticks 18, 19, and 20, which also matches what Charlie said about being in lower engine ticks 18-20.

So a few things to note: Frank's route checks out with what I saw. Charlie's route checks out with what I saw. I was nowhere near cafeteria — I was on the left/bottom side of the map the whole game.

Now, one thing worth flagging: Frank said he saw me "leave storage heading to lower engine around tick 10." But that's not quite right — at tick 10 I was already in storage and HE entered storage from lower engine. I didn't leave storage to lower engine until later. That's a small discrepancy but could just be misremembering.

The bigger question: who was up near cafeteria? None of us four (me, Frank, Charlie, Eve) seem to have been up there based on our stated routes. That leaves Diana. Frank claims Diana was in electrical 22-24, and Charlie saw Diana in upper engine ticks 6-8. Diana's movements need serious explanation — she's the only one whose route hasn't been laid out, and she's the one who could have been near cafeteria with Alice. I want to hear Diana's full route before I commit to a vote.

Alright, thanks everyone. Let me lay out my full route since Bob asked: I started in lower engine, went up to upper engine (where Charlie saw me — ticks 6-8 lines up, I was there around then), then I moved through medbay into electrical, and finally ended up in security where I was when the meeting was called.

So to address Bob's concern directly: I was NOT near cafeteria at any point. My path was lower engine → upper engine → medbay → electrical → security. That's the left-middle-right path across the middle of the map.

Confirmations from my side:
- Charlie in upper engine ticks 6-7, left to lower engine at tick 8 — matches Charlie's stated route.
- Frank in electrical ticks 22-24 — matches his route.
- Eve entering electrical from security at tick 22 — matches Eve's stated route exactly.
- Charlie entering electrical from medbay at tick 24 — matches Charlie's route.

So Frank, Charlie, and Eve all have movements I can personally corroborate. And I can confirm I was in electrical ticks 22-24 with Frank, which matches what Frank said about me.

Here's the problem though: if my route is true (left→middle→right, never cafeteria), and Bob's route is true (navigation→storage→lower engine→upper engine, never cafeteria), and Frank/Charlie/Eve all have routes that don't go to cafeteria either... then who killed Alice in cafeteria?

Bob's route is the LEAST corroborated by me — I never saw him in lower engine or upper engine, even though he claims he was in upper engine when the meeting was called, and I was there earlier. Charlie saw Bob in lower engine 18-20, but no one places Bob in cafeteria — or anywhere near it. However, Bob could have detoured through cafeteria via storage→cafeteria isn't directly connected... 

Actually, looking at the map, cafeteria connects to oxygen, weapons, medbay, and electrical. Frank passed through, Eve and I were in electrical/medbay area but have alibis with each other. 

I'm genuinely torn. My gut says either Frank (who conveniently "found" the body and had access via medbay/electrical to cafeteria) or someone is lying about their route. Frank's route does pass adjacent to cafeteria multiple times. I'd lean slight suspicion on Frank, but I'm not confident enough to hard-commit. If we don't have consensus I'd say skip, otherwise Frank is my pick.

Okay, I've already given my route and observations, so let me respond to what's been said.

First, Diana's pointing the finger at me is a stretch. Yes, my route passed through medbay and electrical — both adjacent to cafeteria — but I had Diana herself, Charlie, and Eve all crossing paths with me in electrical right around ticks 22-25. If I had killed Alice, I would have needed to detour up to cafeteria and back, and my timeline is pretty packed with witnesses on the middle-right of the map.

Second, on Bob's nitpick about tick 10 in storage — fair, I may have misremembered the exact direction, but the key point is we crossed paths in storage around that time, which Bob himself confirms. That's actually mutual confirmation, not a contradiction.

Now here's what bothers me about Diana's speech: she lists detailed corroboration for me, Charlie, and Eve — but notice she conveniently places herself in electrical 22-24 right when Eve and I were there, giving herself a clean alibi window. But what was she doing from tick 8 (when Charlie last saw her in upper engine) until tick 20-22 when she shows up in electrical? That's a 12-14 tick gap. Upper engine to medbay/electrical doesn't take that long. She had plenty of time to detour up to cafeteria via medbay → cafeteria.

Also, Diana claims she saw me leave medbay → electrical at tick 20, but my route had me arriving in electrical around then too — I'll accept that timing.

The cafeteria killer came in via oxygen, weapons, medbay, or electrical. Bob and Charlie were demonstrably on the left/bottom. Eve has a clean security→weapons→electrical→medbay→storage path corroborated by multiple people. That leaves Diana's unaccounted gap as the most suspicious window.

I'm leaning Diana, but I want to hear if anyone can place her somewhere between ticks 8 and 20.

Okay, I've already laid out my route and encounters, so let me just respond to what's developed.

Frank raises a fair point about Diana's gap from tick 8 to ~20. I last saw Diana in upper engine at tick 8, and that's a long window before she reappears in electrical at tick 22. Upper engine → medbay is only 2 ticks, and medbay → cafeteria is adjacent. She'd have had time to detour through cafeteria.

But — I want to push back on Frank too. He says Eve has a "clean" path corroborated by multiple people, and that Bob and I were demonstrably on the left/bottom. That's true for me and Bob (we mutually confirm each other in lower engine 18-20, and Frank himself saw me in oxygen at tick 2). But Frank's own route took him through medbay and into cafeteria at the end — he's literally the one who "found" the body. Self-reports of finding a body are always a bit suspicious.

Here's what I can say concretely:
- Bob's route checks out with mine (lower engine 18-20).
- Frank's tick 2 oxygen sighting of me is real, and I saw him leave oxygen toward upper engine then.
- Diana's tick 6-8 upper engine is confirmed by me.
- I was in medbay around ticks 21-23 heading to electrical, and I did NOT see Diana pass through medbay in that window. If Diana went upper engine → medbay → electrical, she'd have been in medbay before me — possibly tick 9-15, which is consistent with the gap Frank is pointing at.

So Diana's gap is real and unaccounted for. But I'm not 100% — Frank also had medbay/electrical access to cafeteria late.

My lean is Diana over Frank, but only slightly. I want to hear if Eve or Bob can place Diana anywhere between ticks 9 and 21.

To answer Charlie and Frank's question directly: no, I cannot account for Diana anywhere between ticks 9 and 21. Based on the route I laid out earlier, during that entire middle stretch of the round, I was on the right side of the map doing my tasks in security and weapons. I didn't see Diana at all until she popped up in electrical around tick 22.

That means her 12-tick gap is completely unverified by me. Moving from upper engine to medbay definitely doesn't take 12 ticks, which means she had more than enough time to slip into cafeteria, especially since Charlie confirmed she left upper engine around tick 8. 

Charlie makes a completely fair point that Frank self-reporting in cafeteria is inherently something we should be cautious about—we definitely shouldn't give him a totally free pass. But looking at the evidence we have right now, Bob and Charlie mutually clear each other on the bottom left, and my path on the right is corroborated. That really isolates Diana and Frank.

Between the two of them, Diana's missing time is a much bigger, glaring red flag. I'm comfortable voting for Diana here based on that massive gap in her timeline.

Alright, I've heard everyone out. Let me share where I land.

The case against Diana has gotten stronger as people have spoken. Here's what we know:
- Charlie last saw Diana in upper engine at tick 8.
- Diana doesn't reappear in anyone's sightings until tick 22 in electrical (Frank, then Eve at 22, Charlie entering at 24).
- That's a 14-tick gap. Upper engine → medbay is 2 ticks. Medbay → cafeteria is 2 ticks. She had more than enough time to go upper engine → medbay → cafeteria (kill Alice) → medbay → electrical and arrive right at tick 22 to establish her alibi.
- Charlie specifically said he was in medbay around ticks 21-23 and did NOT see Diana pass through. That means if Diana went through medbay, it had to be earlier — consistent with a cafeteria detour.

Now, Charlie raised a fair point about Frank self-reporting the body. I want to address that: Frank's route has him in oxygen early (Charlie confirms tick 2), then lower engine and storage (I confirm tick 10 in storage, mutual confirmation), then medbay/electrical (Diana, Charlie, Eve all confirm electrical at 25). Frank's timeline is densely witnessed throughout the round — he doesn't have a 14-tick gap like Diana does.

My route (navigation → storage → lower engine → upper engine) keeps me far from cafeteria, and Charlie mutually confirms me in lower engine 18-20.

I'm voting Diana. Her gap is the only window in the entire round where someone could have slipped into cafeteria unseen, and no one can place her anywhere during it.

Okay, I've heard everyone, and I need to address the case against me head-on because the "14-tick gap" framing is misleading.

Let me walk through my actual timeline more carefully:
- Ticks 1-8: lower engine → upper engine (Charlie confirms 6-8).
- Tick 8 onward: I left upper engine heading toward medbay. Upper engine → medbay is 2 ticks, so I'd arrive medbay around tick 10-11.
- I was in medbay doing my task there. Tasks take time — that's not a "gap," that's me standing in a room working.
- Then medbay → electrical (2 ticks), arriving electrical around tick 22, which is exactly when Frank and Eve saw me.

Also — and this is important — at tick 12 I personally witnessed Frank entering medbay from storage. So Frank and I were in medbay TOGETHER around tick 12. That directly contradicts the narrative that I was off murdering Alice during my "gap." Frank, you should remember this — you walked into medbay and I was already there.

Charlie, you said you were in medbay around ticks 21-23 and didn't see me — that's correct, because I had already left medbay for electrical by then. The timeline is consistent.

Here's what's suspicious to me now: Frank conveniently omitted that he saw me in medbay at tick 12 when he was building the "Diana has a 14-tick gap" case against me. That's not forgetfulness — that's selective storytelling to frame me.

Frank's route took him through medbay → electrical → cafeteria at the end, and he "found" the body. He had the opportunity, and he's actively suppressing evidence that clears me.

I'm voting Frank.

I found Charlie's body in security. Here's my route: I went navigation → security → weapons → security. 

Key info: I saw Charlie alive in electrical at tick 25, then in weapons at ticks 34-35. At tick 36, Charlie left weapons heading to security. I followed shortly after and found him dead in security.

That means whoever killed Charlie was already in security or arrived right around tick 36-37. I was in weapons when Charlie left, so it wasn't me — and Bob and Eve are the only living suspects. One of them must have been waiting in security or come from the south corridor (navigation side).

Bob, Eve — where were you both? We're down to 3 alive, one of you is the Duck. Speak carefully.

Frank, that sounds like a textbook self-report. Listen to your own timeline: you were alone with Charlie in Weapons, you admit you followed him into Security, and then you miraculously found him dead right after? You're trying to clear yourself by saying "I was in weapons when he left," but you easily could have just chased him into Security, killed him the second you stepped in, and reported it immediately to control the narrative. 

As for me, I went through Security much earlier in the round, but I spent the end of the phase down in Navigation finishing my tasks. I wasn't in Security at tick 36 and I didn't see Charlie. 

Bob, we are at 3 alive, meaning this is for the game. If you were nowhere near Security (like over in the Engines or Cafeteria), then Frank is 100% the Duck trying to pull a fast one on us with a self-report. Let's hear your location, Bob, but all the evidence points directly to Frank.

Alright, here's my situation honestly. My route was oxygen → cafeteria → electrical → cafeteria. I was nowhere near security at tick 36-37 — I was in cafeteria. So I didn't kill Charlie.

That means it's between Frank and Eve, and I have to think carefully here because a wrong vote loses us the game.

Frank's story: he was in weapons with Charlie, Charlie left to security, Frank followed and found the body. That IS a classic self-report pattern — being the last person with the victim and reporting immediately.

Eve's story: she claims she was in navigation finishing tasks at the end. But here's the thing — navigation connects to security (2 ticks). She could have come UP from navigation into security at tick 36 and killed Charlie right as he arrived, then slipped back or stayed.

Honestly, both stories are plausible. But Eve's defense is very aggressive and tries hard to pin it on Frank with the "self-report" angle — which is suspicious because self-reports aren't always guilty, and she's leaning on it heavily. Also, Eve placing herself in navigation puts her in striking distance of security via the south corridor Frank mentioned.

I'm going to vote Eve. Frank gave a detailed timeline with specific ticks; Eve's alibi is vague and conveniently adjacent to the crime scene. If I'm wrong, we lose — but my gut and the geography point to Eve.

Bob, thank you for thinking it through carefully. I want to add one more piece of evidence that I think seals this.

Eve just said she "went through Security much earlier in the round" and spent the end in Navigation. But Navigation is literally 2 ticks from Security via the south corridor. Charlie left weapons at tick 36 heading to security — if Eve was in navigation, she had the perfect window to walk up and kill him right as he arrived.

Also, notice Eve immediately jumped to "self-report" as her entire defense without offering any verifiable details — no ticks, no rooms in order, no witnesses. Compare that to me giving you specific tick numbers and Bob giving a clear room-by-room route.

If I were the Duck, why would I report immediately and put myself under suspicion when I could've just walked away? Charlie's body wasn't going to be found quickly in security.

Bob's logic is sound. I'm voting Eve too. If anyone saw Eve anywhere other than navigation/security at tick 36, speak up — otherwise the geography and her vague alibi point straight at her.

Bob, STOP and think for a second before you lock that vote! Look at the history of this entire game. 

Who reported the first body at tick 27? Frank. And who got ejected because of it? Diana. Now, who miraculously finds Charlie's body and immediately has a perfectly rehearsed timeline to point the finger at me? Frank! He is controlling every single meeting, leading the narrative, and getting us to vote out innocent Geese. He killed Alice, pushed Diana out, and now he killed Charlie and is using my adjacent location as a convenient scapegoat.

Also, think about the mechanics of the game and vision. If I was down in Navigation doing tasks, I would have zero idea that Charlie was walking into Security at exactly tick 36. I wouldn't have seen him coming. But Frank was *with* him in Weapons. Frank knew exactly where Charlie was going, followed him right in, and killed him. He self-reported because he knew he was the last one seen with him and had to control the story before you or I walked in.

Please, Bob, don't let him play you for the win. Frank is the common denominator in every single death and report this game. Vote Frank. If you vote me, he wins. 

Frank

Okay, both of you are giving me strong arguments and this is the game on the line. Let me lay out what I actually know.

Eve, your point about the previous meeting is real — Frank did report Alice's body too, and Diana got voted out. If Diana was innocent, that means a Duck is still alive and Frank has now been the reporter for BOTH bodies. That's a pattern worth noting.

But Frank's counterpoint is also strong: if he were the Duck, self-reporting twice is incredibly risky. And his timeline is specific and falsifiable.

Eve, here's what bothers me about your defense though: you spent your entire first speech attacking Frank without giving any specifics about YOUR route. No tick numbers, no room order, just "I went through security earlier and ended in navigation." That's vague. Frank gave ticks. I gave my full route. You gave a summary.

Also — Eve, you said "I went through Security much earlier in the round." That actually places you in security at some point. Combined with ending in navigation (2 ticks from security), you had both opportunity and a path.

Honestly, I'm torn. The Frank-as-double-reporter pattern is genuinely concerning. But Eve's vague alibi and aggressive deflection feel worse to me.

I'm sticking with my vote: Eve. If I'm wrong, I'm wrong, but Frank gave verifiable details and Eve gave deflection.
